csv_project_name: CMAR for New Lufkin High School Stadium
csv_scope_of_work: Lufkin Independent School District to select a Construction Manager At-Risk (CMAR), via a one-step Request for Competitive Sealed Proposals (RFP) process, for the construction of a new Lufkin High School Stadium, including a new stadium at Lufkin High School with new locker rooms, 8-lane track, turf, lights, scoreboard, sound system, restrooms, concessions, and a new press box resulting from the May 2026 Bond Referendum.
